name: ENTE
author: pcppcp
description: ENTE by op1r is a sidechain compressor: it can listen to something other than the sound it turns down. Put it on a synth, pick track 1 as the source, and the synth ducks every time the drums on track 1 hit. It can also listen to the input, or to a steady beat from the tempo and pump in time with no drums at all. You get anything from house-style pumping to a gentle breath under the drums. The rubber duck on screen gets squashed as ENTE turns the sound down, and it lies flat at 24 dB.
credits: From op1r, ported to kennel by Hundekraft
